subject: pe
title: Respiratory Mechanics
welcome_lead: From tidal volume to vital capacity — how lungs deliver oxygen on demand.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on lung volumes, gas exchange and neural control of breathing.
final_note: Lungs are flow-limited at rest but never the bottleneck in healthy submax exercise.

concepts.def: Air moved per breath at rest, ~500 mL.

Sensors in aortic/carotid bodies detecting pO₂, pCO₂, pH — drive ventilation.

walkthroughs.body_html: Spirometry separates TV, IRV, ERV, RV. VC = TV + IRV + ERV. RV cannot be measured by spirometry alone.
Alveolar pO₂ ~100 mmHg vs pulmonary capillary ~40 mmHg drives O₂ uptake. CO₂ moves opposite.
The brain stem's pre-Bötzinger complex generates respiratory rhythm. Chemoreceptors modulate rate.
